title: Jesus... I Buried My Hope This Year. 🪦
topic: she buried her hope this year and stopped asking, convinced the grief of it was the end of the story

bible.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I buried my hope this year. 🪦

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Grieving it felt like growing up. I stopped asking.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Hope was born in a grave once. That's what resurrection means.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You were begotten again to a lively hope. It doesn't stay buried.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Wanting again isn't weakness. It's hope waking up.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone whose hope went quiet this year. 🕊️
